title: Staff Login chase for pending first login
summary: Admins can send a Staff Login reminder to directory accounts that have not completed first login. The reminder opens Staff Login / Cloudron only — not the public password reset.
changes: Add a Staff Login reminder action on Admin user detail for PENDING FIRST LOGIN directory accounts.
Send chase mail that links to Staff Login / Cloudron and refuse the public-local password reset path for those accounts.
version_rationale: Patch release: adds a Staff Login chase for pending first-login directory users without changing public password reset or Cloudron identity linking.
validation: PHPUnit AdminPendingFirstLoginChaseTest covers directory chase, public-local refusal, confirm gate, and Staff Login mail content.
PHPUnit AdminLocalPublicPasswordResetTest still refuses local password reset for pending first-login accounts.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Chase does not create Cloudron accounts or reset Cloudron passwords; recipients must already exist in the directory and complete Staff Login themselves.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove the Staff Login chase action and reminder mail.
provenance: PENDING FIRST LOGIN Staff Login chase for issue #138, pull request #238.
